data.revised_prompt:
Create a single clean HD / pixel-inspired 2D game FX-only animation sprite sheet for the elite enemy attack effect 'Jay J, the Dragon Prince' AFTER the attack has launched. Use the first reference image only as palette and theme reference: electric cyan, deep blue, ivory white, gold royal sigils, polished aquatic dragon-prince energy. Use the second reference image only as an invisible layout guide for a 3 rows x 4 columns grid with equal frame slots, centered content, consistent spacing, and safe padding. Do NOT draw any character, body, dragon head, face, eyes, claws, hands, armor, cloak, shoulder plates, weapon, creature silhouette, or full dragon. FX-only asset.

Output must be exactly 1536x1024 PNG sprite sheet with exactly 12 frames arranged 3 rows x 4 columns. Entire background must be 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta, including the space between cells. No text, no labels, no UI, no numbers, no watermarks, no visible grid lines, no borders, no guide boxes, no safe rectangles, no center marks, no background elements.

Every frame must contain only the same attack FX identity and same approximate scale, centered in its cell, with all glow, flame, sigils, shards, sparks, shockwaves, trails, and smoke fully inside each cell with clear magenta margin. No frame may touch or cross its cell edge.

Animation concept: 'Royal Dragon Verdict - launched FX'. This is the independent after-attack visual effect that appears in front of the target after the attack. It should feel controlled, powerful, regal, and elite. Compact blue-white royal dragonfire verdict blast with gold law-circle sigils and abstract card-light shards being collected into the blast. High contrast aquatic blue/cyan/white/gold palette, sharp readable silhouette, smooth glow, crisp pixel-inspired edges, polished game sprite style, no painterly rendering, no realistic smoke.

Frame order left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
1. Small cyan spark and faint gold rune circle appear at center, minimal ignition.
2. Spark opens into a tight blue-white spiral, tiny gold card-light shards start orbiting inward.
3. Spiral grows into a compact dragonfire core, ivory-white center and deep blue outer flame.
4. Gold royal sigil ring snaps fully open behind the core, card-light shards align in a circle.
5. Forward blast begins: triangular blue-white flame lance pushes from left-center toward right-center, still compact.
6. Blast thickens with three claw-like cyan flame prongs and gold rune sparks, highest forward motion.
7. Peak impact: bright white-blue burst with a circular gold law seal, card shards pulled into the center, powerful but contained.
8. Shockwave frame: cyan crescent wave expands around the burst, deep blue flame curls backward.
9. Collapse begins: white core dims, gold ring fractures into luminous card-shaped shards.
10. Aftershock: rotating blue flame ribbons and scattered gold shards, smaller than peak.
11. Dissolve: faint cyan embers, pearl sparks, broken rune fragments drifting inward.
12. Loop-ready fade: tiny residual cyan spark and a few gold motes, close to frame 1 but weaker.

Make the attack effect read clearly as an elite enemy magical attack effect, not a body animation.
